Review technical documentation and control engineering changes. Support deployment and multidisciplinary coordination. Prepare technical inputs to site-readiness assessments, implementation plans, and transition-to-service documentation. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical discipline, consistent with applicable contract requirements. At least five years of relevant engineering experience, including at least three years supporting integration, requirements development, or verification of ground-based air traffic management, airport operational systems, aviation surveillance or communications, or comparable real-time aviation systems. Demonstrated experience developing engineering work products, including system requirements, requirements traceability matrices, interface specifications, technical diagrams, test procedures, or verification reports. Candidates must be able to explain their personal contribution to these products. Practical understanding of integrated operational systems that combine field equipment or sensors, network transport, processing software, and operator interfaces. Experience must extend beyond standalone application development or routine office-network support. Working knowledge of IP-based communications and real-time system performance, including TCP/UDP, network segmentation, multicast or comparable data-distribution methods, quality of service, timing and synchronization, and redundancy. Ability to relate these concepts to operational performance and integration requirements. Hands-on integration and testing experience, including use of logs, packet captures, measurements, or other technical evidence to investigate issues. Experience developing or applying pass/fail criteria, documenting defects, and verifying corrective actions. Strong technical-writing and analytical skills, attention to configuration and version control, and the ability to manage assigned engineering tasks with limited day-to-day supervision. Ability to meet applicable government background-investigation and facility or system-access requirements. Experience with sensor-based situational awareness, surveillance-data processing, operational displays, or real-time audio/video systems, including assessment of information quality, latency, synchronization, and operator-interface behavior. Familiarity with system-safety, cybersecurity, human-factors, reliability, or maintainability activities and how those disciplines affect requirements, interfaces, and verification. Experience using requirements-management tools, network-analysis tools, scripting, or data-analysis tools to maintain traceability, investigate system behavior, and summarize test results.
